title: MemberProgramTier
description: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

hasTierBenefit.title: Has Tier Benefit
hasTierBenefit.description: A member benefit for a particular tier of a loyalty program.

hasTierRequirement.title: Has Tier Requirement
hasTierRequirement.description: A requirement for a user to join a membership tier, for example: a CreditCard if the tier requires sign up for a credit card, A UnitPriceSpecification if the user is required to pay a (periodic) fee, or a MonetaryAmount if the user needs to spend a minimum amount to join the tier. If a tier is free to join then this property does not need to be specified.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: MonetaryAmount [value-type]: MonetaryAmount -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; UnitPriceSpecification [value-type]: UnitPriceSpecification -> PriceSpecification -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; CreditCard [entity]: CreditCard -> LoanOrCredit -> FinancialProduct -> Service -> Intangible -> Thing

hasTierRequirement_text.title: Has Tier Requirement (text)
hasTierRequirement_text.description: A requirement for a user to join a membership tier, for example: a CreditCard if the tier requires sign up for a credit card, A UnitPriceSpecification if the user is required to pay a (periodic) fee, or a MonetaryAmount if the user needs to spend a minimum amount to join the tier. If a tier is free to join then this property does not need to be specified.

isTierOf.title: Is Tier Of
isTierOf.description: The member program this tier is a part of.

membershipPointsEarned.title: Membership Points Earned
membershipPointsEarned.description: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: QuantitativeValue [value-type]: QuantitativeValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing
